messages.summary:
## Objective
- Build a complete, playable first-person 3v3 medieval MOBA with two lanes, a jungle, one persistent player character, and modern AAA-inspired graphics and combat animations.

## Requirements
- Do not ask clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions.
- Save small JPEG screenshots for self-checks, viewport at most 1280px wide, and inspect only the latest screenshot.

## Decisions
- Built a self-contained browser game with custom canvas-rendered battlefield art and HTML/CSS HUD; no external game engine or assets.
- Assumed a short, single-player skirmish with allied/enemy AI, persistent Warden identity, relic objectives, medieval essence items, and keyboard/touch controls.

## Work State
### Completed
- Created the game interface, responsive styling, canvas battlefield rendering, combat abilities, AI combatants, objectives, armory, settings, and match-end flow.
- Changes are uncommitted.

### Active
- Verify the game in-browser, fix any runtime or gameplay defects, and capture/inspect the latest small JPEG screenshot.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Run the game using the available project preview workflow and inspect browser console/runtime behavior.
2. Capture and inspect a JPEG screenshot (≤1280px wide); adjust visuals or gameplay as needed.
3. Report the implemented game and any assumptions briefly.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: Game shell and HUD/modals.
- `style.css`: Battlefield interface styling and responsive layouts.
- `game.js`: Canvas renderer, combat simulation, controls, AI, items, objectives, and match flow.

## Important Context
- Game has keyboard movement (WASD), sprint (Shift), attack (click/Space), abilities (Q/E/R), potion (1), interact (F), and armory (B); canvas click requests pointer lock.
- No screenshot or verification has yet been performed.
